name: draw_table_rows_four_planes

name: draw_selected_row_flagged_planes

name: find_record_index_at_point

name: find_record_index_in_frame
description: Searches the collected record table for a position taken from the stack frame with a limit of 140. It returns minus one when nothing matches, otherwise the stored source index.

name: return_stored_record_index
description: Returns the entry of the record index table at the position held in the stack frame as a 32-bit value. It does no other work.

name: wait_for_record_selection_result

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:8DD2
name: poll_flag_set_then_clear

name: pack_clamped_nibble_offsets
description: Adds two frame offsets to two 4-bit fields, clamping each sum to the range zero to fifteen. It returns them packed at bit positions 4 and 8 with the low nibble set to fifteen.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:8E92
name: pack_clamped_nibble_fields_frame
description: Adds three frame offsets to three 4-bit fields, clamping each sum to the range zero to fifteen. It returns the fields packed at bit positions 0, 4 and 8 of one word.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:8EAA
name: pack_clamped_nibble_pair
description: Adds two frame offsets to two 4-bit fields, clamping each sum to the range zero to fifteen. It returns them packed at bit positions 4 and 8.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:8EC8
name: pack_clamped_nibble_with_mask
description: Clamps a frame offset added to a 4-bit field to the range zero to fifteen. It returns that field at bit position 8 with bits 4 to 7 set and the remaining bits taken from a register.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:8ECE
name: pack_nibble_fields_lower_clamp
description: Clamps one field only at zero from below and another field to the range zero to fifteen. It returns both packed with a register value at bit positions 0, 4 and 8.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:8EE6
name: pack_clamped_nibble_high_field
description: Clamps a frame offset added to a 4-bit field to the range zero to fifteen. It returns that field at bit position 8 together with a register value.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:8F04
name: pack_fixed_high_nibbles
description: Packs a register value and a 4-bit field at bit position 4 and sets bits 8 to 11 of the result to one. It returns the combined word.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:8F0A
name: pack_lower_clamped_nibble
description: Clamps a frame offset added to a field at zero from below and packs that field at bit position 8. It combines the result with two register values and returns the word.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:8F22
name: pack_two_nibble_fields
description: Packs a register value and a 4-bit field at bit position 4 and returns the combined word.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:8F3E
name: update_word_table_sixteen_rounds

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:8FBC
name: update_word_table_descending_rounds

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:902A
name: fill_word_table_range
description: Fills table entries in a global area for each index from the first parameter up to the second by calling a helper with two values and storing its result. It is unreached in static flow.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9036
name: fill_word_table_from_frame
description: Fills consecutive table entries in a global area from zero up to a limit taken from the stack frame, calling a helper with two frame values for each entry. It is unreached in static flow.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:915E
name: reset_record_table_and_load
description: Zeroes 255 thirty-byte records, resets two globals and releases any previously loaded handle. key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9276
name: report_database_open_failure
description: Sets the handle to minus one and the status flag to one, then formats the text Couldn't open DATABASE with the parameter through a helper and passes the result to a second helper. It handles a failed database open.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:92D2
name: clear_record_table_and_handle
description: Zeroes several fields in each of 255 thirty-byte records, then if the stored handle is positive releases it through two helpers and sets the handle to minus one.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9362
name: deinterleave_four_word_planes
description: Splits groups of four 16-bit words into four separate planes of a destination array, each plane offset by a count derived from the third parameter. The count is the quarter of its low word multiplied by its high word.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:93D8
name: scatter_four_word_streams
description: Reads four consecutive 16-bit words from a source pointer and writes each to the next slot of four separate destination pointers, repeating for the count held in the stack frame.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:942E
name: read_name_and_find_record
description: Returns minus one if the stored handle is negative. Otherwise it reads a run of bytes into the buffer up to a length given by a helper, then compares it against up to 255 thirty-byte records and returns the first matching index or minus one.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9446
name: read_name_find_record
description: Reads a length-prefixed run of bytes into the buffer parameter, then searches up to 255 thirty-byte records for a match. It returns the matching index or minus one if none matches.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:944A
name: read_bytes_and_find_record
description: Reads bytes into the buffer until a helper reports the end of the run, then searches up to 255 thirty-byte records for a match. It returns the matching index or minus one if none matches.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:94A0
name: return_minus_one_if_full
description: Returns minus one when the index has reached 255, which means no record was found, and otherwise returns the index unchanged.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:94AA
name: return_immediately_empty

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:94AE
name: apply_record_fields_to_handle

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9508
name: copy_bytes_advance_source
description: Copies a given number of bytes from the source pointer in the first parameter into the destination buffer. It then stores the advanced source pointer back through the first parameter.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:951E
name: copy_bytes_to_stored_pointer
description: Copies bytes from a source pointer to a destination until a count from the stack frame is reached. It then stores the advanced source pointer through the pointer slot in the frame.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9802
name: transform_three_nibbles_odd
description: Returns zero for a zero input. Otherwise it maps each of three 4-bit fields to twice its value plus one, masks each to four bits and repacks them into one word.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9868
name: select_and_flip_buffer_entry
description: Looks up a record for the parameter and, when it is valid, updates it. If the current buffer pointer equals a stored pointer it swaps the two buffer pointers after clearing a 200-line area, then calls helpers depending on comparisons of record fields.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9888
name: update_buffer_flip_raster_wait
description: Looks up a record for the parameter and, when the current buffer matches a stored pointer, swaps the two buffer pointers after clearing a 200-line area. It then calls helpers depending on record fields, and one callee busy-waits on the raster beam.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:99A0
name: initialise_display_tables_return_one
description: Copies a two-word block and a thirty-two-byte block from a source into two global areas, sets a global pointer to a fixed 34-byte offset and clears a 200-line area. It then reads sixteen words into a table and returns one.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9A54
name: select_flip_buffer_header
description: Looks up a record for the parameter and, when valid, swaps the two buffer pointers if the current buffer matches a stored one, after clearing a 200-line area. It copies a stored value into a 32-byte stack buffer and calls helpers depending on record fields.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9A78
name: update_buffer_flip_wait_loop
description: Swaps the two buffer pointers when the current buffer matches a stored one, after clearing a 200-line area, then loops over record fields calling helpers. One callee busy-waits on the raster beam and the routine calls an empty function.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9B86
name: parse_extension_and_copy_header

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9BBC
name: parse_extension_at_index
description: Checks for a dot at a given index in a string and, if a character within the length follows it, copies either a 32-byte block alone or a 2-byte block followed by a 32-byte block. It sets a global pointer to a fixed offset and returns one, or zero when no dot is found.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9C0E
name: copy_header_and_set_offset
description: Copies a 2-byte block and a 32-byte block into two buffers, sets a global pointer to a fixed 34-byte offset from the base, and returns one.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9C4A
name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero and does nothing else. It is called from one unnamed routine.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9C50
name: read_sized_block_from_handle
description: Obtains a handle with a fixed code and reads two 16-bit values from it. It then reads a block whose size is the product of those values into the buffer and makes a final helper call on the handle.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9CC8
name: unpack_backward_depacker_stream
description: Decodes a packed stream in a depacker by reading bits through helper calls. It either copies a run of already written bytes or a fixed-length run, writing backwards from the end of the output buffer, and uses a bit-reader and a refill helper to fetch input.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9D1A
name: unpack_literal_run_entry
description: Entry point of a depacker that reads a counted run of literal bytes bit by bit into the output, writing backwards from the end. It then decodes further commands until the output start is reached and optionally spins a delay counter.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9D20
name: unpack_copy_run_entry
description: Entry point of a depacker that copies a run from earlier output at an offset read from the bit stream, then decodes further commands until the output start is reached. It optionally spins a delay counter at the end.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9D3C
name: unpack_fixed_offset_run_entry
description: Entry point of a depacker that advances a run count by two, copies that run from earlier output, and decodes further commands until the output start is reached. It optionally spins a delay counter at the end.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9D5C
name: spin_delay_counter
description: Counts a 32-bit value down to zero in a loop, which serves as a timing delay, and then returns. It is called from one unnamed routine.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9D90
name: return_stack_value_stub
description: Returns the 64-bit value found at the top of the stack without other work. It decodes as a stub with no behaviour of its own.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9D98
name: reset_slot_table_and_reload
description: Releases every non-zero handle in a table of 50 slots of 106 bytes each and clears the slot. It then obtains a handle with a fixed code and, when a record exists, reads its data into a slot if the stored size is under 33001, making several helper calls along the way.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9E56
name: load_slot_handles_from_table
description: Reads a 2-byte value into each of a count of 106-byte slots, then for each non-zero value obtains a handle of size two and stores it in the slot with a helper call. It finishes with a helper call on the handle parameter.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9E8E
name: obtain_slot_handles_for_count
description: For each slot in a count of 106-byte slots whose first word is non-zero, obtains a handle of size two, stores it in the slot and makes two helper calls on the entry. It finishes with a helper call on the handle parameter.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9F48
name: load_slot_record_with_flip
description: Looks up the slot for the parameter and, when valid, obtains a handle of size two from its record. If the record size is under 33001 and the current buffer matches a stored one, it swaps the buffer pointers after clearing a 200-line area, then makes further helper calls.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9F6E
name: load_record_with_buffer_flip
description: Obtains a handle of size two from a record's fields. If the record size is under 33001 and the current buffer matches a stored one, it swaps the buffer pointers after clearing a 200-line area, then makes further helper calls.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:9FEC
name: load_record_flip_raster_wait
description: Swaps the buffer pointers when the current buffer matches a stored one, after clearing a 200-line area, then copies record data through helper calls. One callee busy-waits on the raster beam and the routine calls an empty function.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:A0EC
name: read_slot_table_and_handles
description: Reads a count, then a 2-byte value for each slot into a table of 106-byte slots. For each non-zero value it obtains a handle of size two and makes helper calls on the slot, five helper calls in total.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:A134
name: load_slot_handles_with_flag
description: Reads a 2-byte value into each of a count of 106-byte slots, and for each non-zero value obtains a handle of size two and makes helper calls on the slot. When a status flag is set it makes a final helper call with two frame values.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:A16A
name: obtain_slot_handles_flagged
description: For each slot in a count of 106-byte slots whose first word is non-zero, obtains a handle of size two and makes helper calls on the slot. When a status flag is set it makes a final helper call.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:A22C
